title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer for the distance d between the stars.

title: Resolution Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the formula for angular resolution using the wavelength and diameter of the telescope.

title: Distance Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must accurately calculate the distance between the stars using the angular resolution and the distance from Earth.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the calculations.
